These do not create any third party interest in these shares. As the definition of Encumbrance in the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 is broadly worded, the disclosure has been made on June 09, 2025 out of abundant caution. Thereafter Mr Kuldeep Verma was appointed as the Interim Resolution Professional and subsequently confirmed as the Resolution Professional. As the Resolution Plan could not be finalized within the prescribed timeline, the Committee of Creditors approved the initiation of liquidation proceedings. the Honble NCLAT vide its order dated March 16, 2021, passed the order for liquidation. During the CIRP period, the equity shares of the Company were delisted by the Stock Exchanges. These actions occurred during the moratorium period and were reported as contraventions of Section 14 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Under the Liquidation Regulations, the Liquidator conducted an e-auction for sale of the Company on December 22, 2023. Successful Applicant submitted the highest bid and was declared the successful bidder for acquisition of KS Oils Limited as a going concern. Thereafter Successful Applicant approached the NCLT for requisite directions and approvals for effecting transfer of the Corporate Debtor. The Honble NCLT, Indore Bench, passed an order in this matter on February 3, 2025. Pursuant to the aforesaid order, The new Board was reconstituted and the erstwhile Directors and KMP were deemed to have resigned/vacated office with effect from February 07, 2025. Thereafter the Company filed an application for relisting of its equity shares. The Exchanges thereafter issued a circular withdrawing the delisting, and the status of the equity shares changed from Delisted to Suspended. records.remarksWeb: 1) Indraprastha Medical Corporation Limited (the Company) is a joint venture between the Government of NCT of Delhi (GNCTD) and Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited (AHEL), both being the promoters of the Company.      At the time of incorporation of the Company in 1988, Ms. Vineeta Rai, then an officer of the GNCTD, was one of the subscribers to the Memorandum and Articles of Association (MOA & AOA). Accordingly, one equity share was allotted in her name as a subscriber under the Promoter category. The said share is beneficially owned by the GNCTD and continues to be held in physical form in her name.      The Company has repeatedly requested the GNCTD to transfer the said share from the names of its former officials to the name of the President of India. However, the transfer is yet to be effected.      Ms. Vineeta Rai retired from Government service long ago and was appointed as an Independent Director of the Company with effect from 8 February 2021.      2) Ms. Sangita Reddy (PAN AASPS6786K) is holding 8600 shares which were allotted under the Promoters category in the share capital of the Company. However, shareholding of Ms. Sangita Reddy on the basis of PAN is 9900 shares. Therefore, shareholding of Ms. Sangita Reddy under the Promoter Category in the share capital of the Company is shown as 9900 shares.
